channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Indústria do fumo critica alta do IPI sobre cigarros
item.description: The Brazilian Tobacco Industry Association (Abifumo) criticized the government's increase in the IPI tax on cigarettes, announced by President Lula's administration, stating it 'triggers a critical alert' for the economy and public safety. The association argues the tax hike could negatively impact the sector and lead to social consequences.

item.title: Nunes cobra celeridade do governo após decisão da Aneel: 'Estamos exaustos'
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) urged the federal government to act swiftly in declaring the Enel contract forfeit following a unanimous decision by Aneel’s technical body to deny renewal of the company’s electricity concession in the city. He said residents are 'exhausted' by recurring power supply issues.

item.title: Mendonça é sorteado para relatar ação de Bolsonaro contra Janones
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça has been randomly assigned as rapporteur of a criminal complaint filed by Jair Bolsonaro against federal deputy André Janones. The case stems from Janones’ remarks calling Bolsonaro a 'thief' and 'vagabond', and accusing him of ordering the killing of Lula and Alckmin. Bolsonaro’s defense seeks conviction for slander, defamation, and insult, plus moral damages compensation.

item.title: 'É guerra, não ganância': o que ameaça o pacote de Lula para segurar o preço do diesel
item.description: The Lula government announced an expanded subsidy package to curb diesel price increases, aiming to prevent further economic and political impacts, especially in light of the 2018 truckers' strike. Measures include higher subsidies for domestic producers and greater discounts for imported diesel in participating states, though experts warn the effect will be limited due to international uncertainty and resistance from major fuel companies to join the program.

item.title: “Na prática, é uma intervenção política”: demissão na Petrobras acende alerta no mercado
item.description: The federal government attempted to curb rising fuel and cooking gas prices through tax exemptions, subsidies, and state-level coordination, but the dismissal of a Petrobras director following a high-premium gas auction was seen as political interference, raising concerns about the company's autonomy, governance, and market confidence.

item.title: Governo desistiu de enviar PL próprio sobre fim da 6 X 1, diz Motta
item.description: Speaker of the Chamber of Deputies Hugo Motta announced that the Lula government has withdrawn its plan to send a constitutional urgency bill on ending the 6×1 work scale, opting instead to await the PEC on the matter. The PEC will be voted on in the CCJ next week, and if approved, a special committee will be immediately established to discuss reducing the workday, with a vote expected in May before the elections.

item.title: A projeção de Kassab sobre o desempenho de Caiado na eleição
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, stated that 15% of votes for pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado would be 'great', even if it doesn't lead to a runoff, emphasizing the importance of a political alternative. He noted that such a vote share would allow the party to negotiate support in exchange for specific policy demands. The projection comes ahead of the release of a new Ideia poll with 1,500 interviews and a 2.5-point margin of error.

item.title: Indígenas pedem maior proteção às suas terras durante marcha em Brasília
item.description: Thousands of indigenous people from across the country marched in Brasília to demand faster demarcation of indigenous lands by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s government and to protest against Congress, six months ahead of the elections in which Lula seeks re-election.

item.title: Em ritmo de pré-campanha, marqueteiro de Lula diz a deputados do PT para reforçar presença digital
item.description: Raul Rabelo, marketing strategist and partner of Communications Minister Sidônio Palmeira, presented initial campaign strategies for Lula’s 2026 re-election bid to the PT caucus in the Chamber of Deputees, stressing the need to strengthen digital presence through social media, supporter accounts, and influencers. The 26-slide presentation highlighted themes such as ending the 6x1 work schedule, combating family debt, and contrasting Lula’s legacy with Bolsonaro’s, while noting that the 'blusinhas' tax is the most unpopular measure of Lula’s government, opposed by 70% of Brazilians. Rabelo urged the campaign to portray Lula as aligned with workers and the most vulnerable.

item.title: Alcolumbre evita previsão para votação de Messias: ‘Pretendo falar com os líderes’
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre avoided giving a timeline for the vote on Jorge Messias' Supreme Court nomination, saying he intends to speak with party leaders and the CCJ president, Otto Alencar. The nomination was sent by the government last week and now awaits Alcolumbre's referral to the Constitution and Justice Committee. Although the government supports Messias, Alcolumbre had previously advocated for Rodrigo Pacheco for the vacancy.

item.title: Lula assina MP que destina recursos de bets à Polícia Federal
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva issued Provisional Measure No. 1.348/2026, allocating part of sports betting revenue to the Federal Police's Funapol fund. The measure starts at 1% in 2026, increases to 2% in 2027, and settles at 3% from 2028, potentially reaching R$ 200 million annually. Funds may also support the Federal Highway and Penal Police, and accept donations and international crime-fighting transfers.

item.title: Prefeito de Salvador critica Lula: ‘Ficou tomando whisky até tarde’; veja vídeo
item.description: The mayor of Salvador, Bruno Reis (União), criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for not attending the inauguration of the Residencial Zulmira Barros, claiming Lula spent the night 'drinking whisky until late' at the Palácio de Ondina. Reis said the president's absence showed lack of commitment, while the federal government claims the municipality delayed issuing the required Habite-se permit. The event, part of the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program, was initially postponed due to missing documentation but was authorized by the city despite the lack of the permit.

item.title: Pacote de Lula contra dívidas avalia uso do FGTS e limites a apostas
item.description: The Lula government is studying a new debt relief package inspired by the Desenrola program, offering up to 80% discounts on high-interest debts such as credit card overdrafts and personal loans, using FGTS as collateral, and restricting online gambling access for participants. The proposal remains in early draft form and requires further negotiation with financial institutions and impact assessment on the FGTS fund.

item.title: Após encontro com Alcolumbre, relator diz que CPI do Crime não será prorrogada
item.description: The rapporteur of the Organized Crime CPI, Alessandro Vieira, said the commission will not be extended after a meeting with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, and will conclude its work on May 14. Vieira called the decision unilateral and regretted the lack of time to deepen investigations, ruling out for now an appeal to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Fazenda quer limitar endividamento com bets em novo Desenrola
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced that the Lula government plans to restrict access to betting and digital gambling platforms as a condition for beneficiaries of the new Desenrola Brasil program, aiming to prevent reindebtedness after debt renegotiation. The initiative targets high-cost, problematic credit lines such as credit card revolving, overdraft, and consumer direct credit (CDC). The government is also evaluating the use of FGTS funds to guarantee renegotiated installments, in coordination with the Ministry of Labor to ensure the fund’s sustainability.

item.title: Escala 6x1: Motta diz que proposta deverá ser votada na semana que vem na CCJ; governo cogitou propor novo texto
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced that the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule will be voted in the CCJ next week and in plenary by the end of May. The Lula government had considered sending a constitutional urgency bill but abandoned the idea after agreeing with Motta to keep the PEC’s track. The PEC proposes a 36-hour workweek with three days off, while the government had advocated for 40 hours with two days off and no salary reduction.

item.title: PT e Lula determinam apoio ao PDT no RS, e diretório gaúcho se revolta
item.description: PT leaders in Rio Grande do Sul are resisting an alliance with the PDT, centered around former state deputy Juliana Brizola, despite a request from President Lula and a directive from the national directory. The move reflects internal party tensions in the state over electoral strategy for 2026. While the PDT alliance is driven by national leadership, it faces strong local opposition.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sem vice? Zema recusa chapa para as eleições 2026
item.description: Romeu Zema, governor of Minas Gerais, declined an offer to be the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket for the 2026 elections, according to media reports. The decision undermines the strategy of Bolsonaro's son to forge an alliance with regional centrão leaders. Zema aims to preserve his political independence and focus on his own re-election bid in Minas Gerais in 2026.

item.title: A invertida de Fux em Witzel e no PL em torno da sucessão no Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux rejected requests from the PL and Democrata parties to participate as amici curiae in the case defining the rules for the interim gubernatorial election in Rio de Janeiro. The PL sought to advance Douglas Ruas’s candidacy via the Alerj presidency, while the Democrata backed former governor Wilson Witzel, who was removed in 2021. Fux doubted the legal standing of both parties, stating the PL aimed to file a claim in its own name and the Democrata failed to demonstrate a direct legal interest suitable for amicus curiae participation.

item.title: Lei garante folga para exames preventivos; veja quais
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law No. 15.377/2026, granting workers up to three days of paid leave every 12 months to undergo preventive medical exams, including screenings for HPV, breast, cervical, and prostate cancer. The law amends the CLT, requires employers to inform employees about access to diagnostic services and official HPV vaccination and cancer awareness campaigns, and originated from Bill PL 4968/2020, authored by former Senator Rose de Freitas (MDB-ES) and reported by Senator Leila Barros (PDT-DF).

item.title: FGTS para refinanciamento e limite para bets: Lula estuda plano contra o endividamento de famílias
item.description: The Lula government is studying the authorization to use the FGTS (Severance Fund) to refinance household debts as part of a package to reduce indebtedness ahead of the 2026 election. The measure would be paired with limits on virtual betting (bets) as a countermeasure to prevent re-indebtedness after relief. Finance Minister Dario Durigan confirmed the discussion with Labor Minister Luiz Marinho, noting the economic team is assessing the FGTS impact.

item.title: TSE alerta para golpe com cobrança para regularização de pendências eleitorais
item.description: The TSE warns that false messages are circulating via apps like WhatsApp, claiming electoral pendencies and demanding payment for regularization, which is fraudulent. All electoral services, including issuance of first title, address transfer, and data updates, are free and must be accessed only through official channels: electoral courts, Electoral Self-Service, or e-Title. The TSE emphasizes it does not charge for these services and advises distrusting external links with fake logos imitating official sites.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aciona Justiça para obter dados de perfis críticos a ele no X
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) filed a lawsuit against X to obtain personal data of five critical profiles, claiming a defamatory campaign and invoking an STF thesis on platform liability. The judge granted five days for data disclosure but rejected secrecy; X appealed, halting the process. The company argues for freedom of expression, stating the criticisms concern public topics already widely debated.

item.title: Crusoé: O que André Marinho já falou sobre o bolsonarismo
item.description: Comedian and presenter André Marinho announced his candidacy for governor of Rio de Janeiro under the Novo party and expressed intent to renew his partnership with the Bolsonaro family, referencing their 2018 alliance. He made the statement in a video alongside Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president. The article was first published on O Antagonista.

item.title: Bolsonaro apresenta queixa-crime contra André Janones no STF
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense filed a criminal complaint at the STF against federal deputy André Janones over social media statements calling Bolsonaro a 'vagabond', 'thief', and 'pervert', and alleging without evidence that he ordered the killing of Lula and Alckmin. Janones responded with further insults on Instagram, calling Bolsonaro a 'filthy worm'. The complaint claims the remarks exceed free speech protections and notes Bolsonaro is under house arrest following his 27-year sentence for coup attempt, limiting his ability to respond publicly.

item.title: Motta diz que governo Lula recuou de projeto com urgência sobre a escala 6×1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta said the Lula government withdrew its plan to send a bill to change the 6×1 work schedule under urgency rules, after he advocated for constitutional amendment (PEC) processing. The Executive agreed to the legislative approach, keeping the schedule for voting on the PEC’s admissibility in the CCJ and committee review through May. Motta also noted progress on the bill regulating work relationships for app-based drivers and delivery workers.

item.title: “Prefiro ser tratado como louco do que ser amigo do Valdemar”, diz Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, president of the Missão party and pre-candidate for the Presidency, responded to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's remarks about his psychiatric conditions, stating he would rather be called 'crazy' than be an ally of Senator Valdemar Costa Neto. The statement was made in a video shared on social media on Tuesday, the 7th, in reply to comments from the Inteligência LTDA podcast.

item.title: Treta de Eduardo Bolsonaro e Nikolas multiplica interações da direita nas redes sociais
item.description: A public feud between Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira sparked over 500,000 social media interactions, fueling the 'ego clash' meme and exposing internal divisions within Bolsonarism. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has publicly urged unity around his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy, as supporters demand maturity and opponents seize the rift as evidence of the movement’s weakening cohesion.

item.title: Ala do STF avalia que há tempo para eleição direta no Rio até julho, mas deve discutir mandato de governador interino até outubro
item.description: A faction of the STF led by Alexandre de Moraes, Gilmar Mendes, Flávio Dino, and Cristiano Zanin believes there is time to hold direct elections for Rio’s governorship by July, but prefers a single election in October as a compromise to avoid two votes this year. They argue that Claudio Castro’s resignation one day before his TSE conviction for political abuse was a deliberate maneuver to evade a direct election and maintain his political group’s power via an indirect vote by Alerj. The ministers cite institutional crisis, criminal influence in state institutions, and the Marielle Franco case as context justifying direct elections.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira anuncia voto favorável a Messias para o STF
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira, national president of the PP, announced he will vote in favor of Jorge Messias’s nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, citing Messias’s professional trajectory and strong ties to Piauí. Although he would have preferred a nomination from former President Jair Bolsonaro, Nogueira said he respects Lula’s choice and each senator’s personal decision. As of March 31, Messias had only 25 declared senatorial supports, short of the 41 votes needed for approval in the Senate plenary.

item.title: Sessão na Câmara homenageia 22ª edição do Acampamento Terra Livre
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies held a solemn session to honor the 22nd edition of the Acampamento Terra Livre, which gathers over 7,000 people in Brasília until Saturday. The session, presided by Deputy Célia Xakriabá, emphasized the importance of indigenous land demarcation for environmental protection, climate crisis mitigation, and democratic strengthening. Deputies Sônia Guajajara and Marina Silva stressed that indigenous territories are not commodities and are essential for Brazil to meet its environmental goals.

item.title: O bolsonarismo que perdoa
item.description: Despite its reputation for publicly condemning traitors, Bolsonarism is moving toward reconciliation with previously estranged allies ahead of the 2026 presidential elections. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is leading this effort to pardon and reapproach figures who had been sidelined. The shift reflects a strategic attempt to broaden political support in anticipation of the presidential race.

item.title: “Não é o rosto de um líder confiante”, diz neta de Lula sobre Flávio
item.description: Influencer Bia Lula, granddaughter of President Lula, criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s appearance and tone in an Instagram video, saying he looked exhausted and lacking confidence, signaling political fatigue ahead of a potential 2026 presidential campaign. She linked this to internal divisions among Bolsonaro allies, citing the public feud between Eduardo Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira on social media as evidence of the right’s fragmentation. Bia concluded the situation reflects not a coherent political project, but a 'cry for help' driven by familial and ideological conflicts.

item.title: Skaf faz jantar para Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio, Nunes e empresários
item.description: Fiesp president Paulo Skaf hosted a dinner at his home on April 6, 2026, for pre-presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), alongside São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB), joined by about 20 business leaders representing R$750 billion in revenue and 2 million jobs. The meeting aimed to strengthen Bolsonaro’s ties with the productive sector and showcase unified political and business support. Flávio’s campaign coordinator, Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), also attended.

item.title: Governo pode liberar FGTS para pagamento de dívidas, confirma ministro da Fazenda
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan confirmed that the Lula government is evaluating the use of a portion of the FGTS (Unemployment Guarantee Fund) to refinance household debts, in coordination with the Ministry of Labor. The measure, still under study, aims to reduce income commitment by assisting both delinquent households (with debts 60–360 days overdue) and current but over-indebted families through debt renegotiation and migration to cheaper credit lines. The government is also considering using R$10.5 billion in forgotten bank funds to strengthen the FGO and expand reach, though with caution due to risks to the fund’s stability.

item.title: Próxima do Frei Gilson e ex-MDB: quem é o nome do PP de SP para vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, met in São Paulo with federal deputy Simone Marquetto, who is being advocated by the São Paulo faction of the PP as a potential vice-presidential running mate. The meeting highlights bolsonarist efforts to expand their base in Brazil’s largest electoral college.

item.title: Pré-candidato, Tarcísio diz ser a favor de PEC que acaba com a reeleição
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas declared his support for a PEC that would end presidential reelection, arguing that reelection is harming Brazil and needs to be questioned. He emphasized that political reform is essential to improve representativity and institutional functioning. The PEC, authored by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, was approved in the CCJ but remains stalled in the Senate.

item.title: Em São Paulo, Mendonça saúda Messias e diz que bom magistrado precisa ser ‘prudente e íntegro’
item.description: In São Paulo, STF Minister André Mendonça greeted Attorney General Jorge Messias, emphasizing that a good judge must be prudent and integrity, without citing specific cases but alluding to the Supreme Court's credibility crisis involving suspected conflicts of interest with private actors. Mendonça also wished Messias luck in his Senate confirmation hearing, which could lead to a STF vacancy.

item.title: Governo avalia liberar parte do FGTS para o pagamento de dívidas
item.description: The Lula government is evaluating allowing the use of FGTS funds to pay off debts, in coordination with the Ministry of Labor, to assist indebted families. The proposal includes consolidating multiple debts into a single loan with lower interest rates and potential principal discounts of up to 80%, alongside restrictions on gambling spending. The goal is to alleviate household debt and improve public perception of Brazil’s economic situation.

item.title: Paulo Serra será candidato ao governo de São Paulo pelo PSDB, afirma Aécio
item.description: Paulo Serra, former mayor of Santo André and PSDB member, will be the party's candidate for governor of São Paulo, according to national party president Aécio Neves. The decision follows the PSDB's withdrawal of support from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) due to his direct ties to the Bolsonaro family. Serra will be presented as a third-way alternative in the state election, positioned against the polarization between Tarcísio and Fernando Haddad (PT), with the goal of boosting PSDB candidates for the state legislature and federal Chamber.

item.title: Governo avalia limite para dívidas com bets, diz ministro da Fazenda
item.description: The Lula government is considering imposing a limit on sports betting (bets) debt as a condition for accessing new credit lines aimed at reducing household indebtedness. The plan includes a simplified debt renegotiation program, similar to Desenrola, targeting expensive credit modalities like credit cards, overdrafts, and unsecured personal loans, with priority for low-income households and those with high debt-to-income ratios. Finance Minister Dario Durigan said the goal is to improve public perception of the country's economic situation six months ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: O BBB 26 mostra como a eleição de 2026 será disputada no celular
item.description: BBB 26 functions as a real-world laboratory of mass communication in Brazil, revealing how narratives are constructed, retained, and activate belonging at scale. According to Zuza Nacif, CEO of Brasil Comunicação, the show offers key lessons for the 2026 elections: winning voter attention requires consistency, clarity, and persistence in the continuous digital environment spanning TV, social media, and clips. The program’s audience and engagement metrics — over 115 million viewers and 21 billion views — demonstrate that 2026 political campaigns will be defined by the ability to occupy the voter’s mobile device with simplified yet powerful messages.

item.title: Câmara marca para a próxima semana votação para vaga no TCU
item.description: The President of the Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), has scheduled a vote for next Tuesday, the 14th, to determine the Chamber’s nominee for the vacant ministerial position at the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU), following the compulsory retirement of Aroldo Cedraz. The information was confirmed by party leaders to O Antagonista.

item.title: PGR defende eleição direta no Rio
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) advocated for a direct election to choose a new governor of Rio de Janeiro as a 'stopgap mandate' until the end of 2026. The position was presented on the eve of the STF judgment on two related actions concerning state succession. The PGR argues that the measure would ensure democratic legitimacy and institutional stability.

item.title: “Não é sobre comando, não é sobre ordem. É sobre convicção”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, stated that his political base is driven by conviction, not orders, emphasizing that the people have decided to rise up to rescue Brazil. He said he faces attacks, pressure, and attempts at demobilization, accusing opponents of using public funds and state machinery unfairly, and called for mobilization and unity among his supporters.

item.title: Relatório final da PEC da aposentadoria compulsória 'é uma vacina' contra demora para afastar magistrado, diz Eliziane Gama
item.description: Senator Eliziane Gama (PT-MA), rapporteur of the PEC that abolishes compulsory retirement as punishment for judges, described the final report of the proposal as 'a vaccine' against delays in removing magistrates involved in disciplinary infractions. The PEC, proposed by Flávio Dino in February 2024, replaces compulsory retirement with stricter sanctions such as removal from office, and already has support from a March 2024 STF decision that ordered the CNJ to apply this penalty as the maximum disciplinary sanction. The vote in the Senate’s CCJ is scheduled for Wednesday (8).

item.title: Prefeitos veem Alckmin como trunfo de Haddad no interior de SP
item.description: São Paulo interior mayors see Geraldo Alckmin as a key asset to boost Fernando Haddad’s gubernatorial campaign, leveraging his moderate image to attract centrist voters and strengthen the PT in the state’s interior. The strategy aims to challenge Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election, with Haddad likely facing him again in a competitive 2026 runoff, similar to 2022 but with improved prospects for the PT.

item.title: Lula recebe elenco de “Por Um Fio” no Cine Alvorada
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva hosted the cast of the film 'Por Um Fio', inspired by Drauzio Varella's book and depicting the construction of the SUS during Brazil's redemocratization, at a special screening in the Cine Alvorada at the Palácio da Alvorada, accompanied by First Lady Janja. The event took place on Tuesday, April 7, 2026, at 7 p.m., featuring actors such as Bruno Gagliasso and Rômulo Estrela, and is part of a series of cultural screenings promoting Brazilian films that highlight social and historical themes.

item.title: SP e RJ têm os menores índices de eleitores adolescentes do país; Nordeste e Norte têm os maiores
item.description: São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro have the lowest percentages of adolescent voters in the country, at 11.7% and 11.3% respectively, well below the national average of 20.3%. In contrast, Northern and Northeastern states lead in youth participation, with Rondônia at the top (40.5%), followed by Tocantins, Piauí, Maranhão, Ceará, and Amapá, all above 30%. UNICEF and the TSE launched a national campaign to encourage youth voter registration before the May 6 deadline.

item.title: PT determina apoio a Juliana Brizola e partido não terá candidato ao governo do RS pela primeira vez
item.description: The national leadership of the Workers' Party (PT) has decided to support Juliana Brizola (PDT) as the pre-candidate for governor of Rio Grande do Sul in 2026, marking the first time the party will not field its own candidate in the state. The decision, made by the Electoral Working Group (GTE), calls for building a joint electoral strategy with the PDT and other democratic forces under Brizola’s leadership, while designating Edegar Pretto as the most legitimate figure to lead the coordination — despite Pretto’s insistence on continuing his own pre-campaign.
